dashboard.title: JEPA + SVM Pipeline
dashboard.subtitle: Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) with Support Vector Machine for robust classification
dashboard.feature_jepa: JEPA (Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture) — Self-supervised learning: Encoder + Target Encoder (EMA) + Predictor, MSE loss on embeddings
dashboard.feature_svm: Support Vector Machine (SVM) — GridSearchCV on JEPA embeddings, RBF kernel with optimized C and gamma
dashboard.feature_minmax: MinMaxScaler + GridSearch — Scales data to [-1, 1] and auto-tunes SVM hyperparameters (C, gamma)
dashboard.feature_end_to_end: End-to-End Pipeline — Raw data → MinMaxScaler(-1,1) → JEPA self-supervised → supervised fine-tune → embeddings → SVM classification
dashboard.table_desc: Evaluation with JEPA self-supervised + supervised fine-tuning, MinMaxScaler(-1,1), 5-Fold CV.
dashboard.table_conclusion: JEPA+SVM pipeline achieves competitive results against published SVM/kernel methods across multiple benchmark datasets.
dashboard.about_desc: JEPA+SVM pipeline: (1) MinMaxScaler normalizes data to [-1, 1]. (2) JEPA self-supervised learning via feature masking + MSE loss between predicted and target embeddings, with EMA target encoder updates. (3) Supervised fine-tuning with CrossEntropy + Contrastive loss. (4) Extract embeddings from JEPA Encoder. (5) SVM (RBF kernel) with GridSearchCV classifies on embeddings. Combines deep representation learning with SVM discriminative power.
dashboard.about_legend: Pipeline: Raw → Scaler → JEPA self-supervised → Fine-tune → Embeddings → SVM
